Arrangement of ternary expressions

resharper_csharp_nested_ternary_style #

Arrangement of ternary expressions — Nested ternary expression style. Observable and not implemented: all four values are distinct on a flat nested chain, measured one at a time against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6 at a 120-column margin. autodetect (the export's value, and what Skala writes) chops one member per line if the chain is long or already multiline; compact is the same layout chopped always, so a chain that fits is chopped too; expanded writes the staircase, breaking before every ? and : with one further indent level per nesting depth; simple_wrap fills at the signs, breaking at the last ? or : that does not fit. Promotion is the last three layouts, of which expanded needs the progressive per-depth indent the writer does not yet produce — a chain the author wrote as a staircase comes back from Skala with every arm at one level. None of it is governed by wrap_ternary_expr_style or wrap_before_ternary_opsigns, which leave every chain byte-identical.

Typeone of simple_wrap, autodetect, compact, expanded
Defaultautodetect
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
